correctness.rationale: The cyclic determinant is 1+u(-w)^(n-1), nonzero in the specified range. The cofactor normal solves C^T z=D1. Its first entry is the alternating sum s and two coordinate differences are (u-w) times coprime coefficients, so its coordinate gcd is gcd(|s|,|u-w|). The primitive-normal covolume/index identity turns this gcd into intrinsic normalized volume. All parameter quantifiers and affine-lattice normalization are explicit. A standalone exact-integer maximal-minor checker passes 264 cases but is not relied upon for infinite proof.
